craft_notes: Sthayin pranaya-sama; color = bondage (first darkness-verse; Guru teaching). Sanskrit: gṛhīta-paśu-bhāvaḥ — 'taken-fettered-state': Śiva HIMSELF having taken the beast-state (eva). Firing: (a) saṃtāna (thread/continuum) -> 'skein' kept (L3's best word); (b) tatra... tatra (there... there) anaphora -> kept, the two theres facing each other across the break; (c) eva (indeed!) -> colon before 'Śiva himself' IS the camatkara — the revelation after the list. Line-1 comma->dash (skein held, turn to the enjoyer). Close on 'beast' (bright ee, unsettled — the fetter does NOT resolve; no santa-close where bondage is the doctrine).

craft_notes: Sthayin pranaya-sama; color = stainless containing (yathā...tadvat simile architecture). Sanskrit: amalaḥ sphaṭikaḥ (stainless crystal) takes varṇa (colors/sorts) without staining; sura-mānuṣa-paśu-pādapa bare list. Firing: (a) simile hinge yathā/tadvat -> 'As... so...' kept, dash suspends the protasis; (b) bare four-noun list -> stripped L3's 'of/and' padding to drumbeat catalogue 'god, man, beast, and plant' (compounds restored); (c) stainless-taking-stains paradox left standing, unstated (suggestion-rank: never name it). Close on 'plant' (grounded, open — analogy doesn't settle).

craft_notes: Sthayin pranaya-sama; color = motion-in-stillness. Sanskrit: gacchati gacchati (moves, moves — doubled verb) + sthite sthitiṃ yāti (in-stillness stillness-goes — polyptoton, untranslatable; L3's 'still, stillness' echo kept). Firing: (a) doubled motion vs stillness-goes -> line 1 runs (semicolons = flowing water), dash releases into application; (b) iva (as) simile kept loose; (c) maheśānaḥ (great-Lord) closes line 2 — person, not abstraction, carries the mass. Close on 'worlds' (plural, open — the mass moves; no settle where motion is doctrine). Form note: song has found its gait (dash-turn couplets); consistency within the song IS song-ness.

craft_notes: Sthayin pranaya-sama; color = repletion (song-close). Song p01 closes open-infinite. Read aloud: processional, then release.
